note: These numbers are frozen before the runner is executed and must not be relaxed after seeing a result. If a gate fails, the branch is: report the failing path, propose the minimal suite change, and say what must be re-frozen. See DEVIATIONS.md for the two places where the assignment left the scale of a quantity open and this file had to choose one.

theta.comment: INTERFACE.md section 4's --seed, and section 7's tau DERIVED rather than assumed since the 2026-09-22 re-freeze: tau = min(30 s, max(10 s, 10 x p99)) with p99 measured on the calibration set over the candidates the task actually runs (baseline, PC, its truncations, C*(T1)'s ok rows). Pooled p99 = 133-136 ms over two runs, so 10 x p99 = 1.33-1.36 s and the 10 s floor binds: tau = 10 s. This replaces the earlier 30 s, which was the band maximum with no p99 behind it (D-GATE-4, now closed). Evidence: tau_calibration.json.

sets.comment: The gate is decided on dev only. eval numbers are recorded separately and are diagnostic: the pre-registered demand is (v) that an improvement hold on unseen instances, so eval must not be usable to tune the gate.

quantities.delta_i: (p_i - b_i) / |E_i|, exact rational. The improvement in the objective, in edges, as a fraction of the instance's edges. b_i and p_i are E*'s recomputed cut_edges.
quantities.rho_i: (T_i - p_i) / (T_i - b_i), exact rational, T_i = OPT_i when opt_certified else R_i (a lower bound on the optimum).
quantities.baseline_headroom_i: (T_i - b_i) / T_i, exact rational. How much of the target the baseline leaves on the table.

delta_gate.aggregation: unweighted mean of the per-graph exact rationals; per-family means are over that family's graphs alone, so one easy family cannot carry the overall mean
delta_gate.unscored_policy: a graph whose b_i or p_i is not ok is excluded from every mean and counted in `unscored`; it is never folded in as 0 (INTERFACE.md section 6 rule 5)

rho_gate.median_definition: exact midpoint of the two central order statistics for an even count, the central value for an odd count; ordering is on the exact rational, never on a float

saturation_no_go.also_fails_if: any graph in the set has T_i == b_i (the baseline already attains the reference)
saturation_no_go.comment: A veto, not a threshold to tune: if the baseline already sits at the reference there is nothing for a substrate to improve.
